properties.areaDesc: Conecuh, AL; Covington, AL; Crenshaw, AL; Escambia, AL
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 10 at 7:55AM CDT until October 10 at 10:00AM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall from Hurricane Isaias
continues.

* WHERE...Southeastern Conecuh County in south central Alabama...
Covington County in south central Alabama...
Southern Crenshaw County in south central Alabama...
Eastern Escambia County in south central Alabama...

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Expect many
areas of slow moving or standing water. It will take several hours
for all the water from these storms to work through local drainage
systems in urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 754 AM CDT, Residual flooding continues from heavy rain that
fell from Hurricane Isaias. Between 6 and 12 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Andalusia, Opp, Brewton, Florala, East Brewton, Brantley, River
Falls, Red Level, Lockhart, Dozier, Heath, Gantt, Glenwood,
Riverview, Carolina, Beck, Stanley, Red Oak, Loango and Rhump.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL 10 AM CDT THIS MORNING

properties.areaDesc: Coastal waters from Murrells Inlet to South Santee River SC out 20 NM
properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued October 10 at 8:53AM EDT until October 10 at 9:45AM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
properties.description:
For the following areas...
Coastal waters from Murrells Inlet to South Santee River SC out 20
NM...

At 853 AM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing waterspouts
was located 5 NM south of East Bank Buoy, moving north at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts to 40 knots.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

Locations impacted include...
Winyah Bay Sea Buoy, Georgetown Nearshore Wreck, East Bank Buoy, C
J Davidson Wreck and Georgetown Reef.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes. If caught on the
open water, prepare for deteriorating conditions.

NWSheadline: SPECIAL MARINE WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 945 AM EDT

properties.areaDesc: Okaloosa, FL; Santa Rosa, FL
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 10 at 7:53AM CDT until October 10 at 10:00AM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall from Hurricane Isaias
continues.

* WHERE...Okaloosa County in northwestern Florida...
Santa Rosa County in northwestern Florida...

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Streams
continue to rise due to excess runoff from earlier rainfall. It
will take several hours for all the water from these storms to work
through local drainage systems in urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 753 AM CDT, broadcast media reported heavy rain in the warned
area from Hurricane Isaias. Flooding is already occurring.
Between 6 and 12 inches of rain have fallen.
- Flooding impacts will continue, but no additional rainfall is
expected.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Wright, Fort Walton Beach, Crestview, Niceville, Destin, Eglin
AFB, Milton, Valparaiso, Mary Esther, Bagdad, Ocean City, Lake
Lorraine, Baker, Navarre, Shalimar, Laurel Hill, Cinco Bayou,
Roeville, Point Baker and Navarre Beach.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL 10 AM CDT THIS MORNING

properties.areaDesc: Eastern Alaska Range South of Trims Camp
properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 10 at 4:51AM AKDT until October 11 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Snow begins Saturday morning then becomes
heavier Saturday night with total snow accumulations up to 8 inches
by Sunday evening. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph may result in
areas of blowing snow.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range South of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 4 PM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...An early season snowfall is expected late tonight through
Sunday. Roads and especially bridges are likely to become slick and
snow covered.
properties.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

NWSheadline: WINTER WEATHER ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 4 PM THIS AFTERNOON TO 4 PM AKDT SUNDAY

properties.areaDesc: Southern Denali Borough
properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 10 at 4:51AM AKDT until October 11 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations up to 8 inches along
portions of the Parks Highway. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph may
result in areas of blowing snow.

* WHERE...Southern Denali Borough, especially south of Denali Park.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...An early season snowfall is expected tonight through
Saturday night. Rain may mix in on Saturday, but roads and
especially bridges are likely to become slick and snow covered.
properties.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

NWSheadline: WINTER WEATHER ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 7 AM AKDT SUNDAY

properties.areaDesc: Northern Denali Borough
properties.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 10 at 4:46AM AKDT until October 11 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 35 to 45 mph with gusts up to 70 mph.

* WHERE...Northern Denali Borough.

* WHEN...Until 1 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds could blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
properties.instruction:
Use extra caution when driving, especially if operating a high
profile vehicle. Secure outdoor objects.

NWSheadline: HIGH WIND WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 1 AM AKDT SUNDAY

properties.areaDesc: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
properties.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 10 at 4:46AM AKDT until October 11 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 75 mph.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds may blow down trees and power lines.
Travel will be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.
properties.instruction:
People should avoid being outside in forested areas. Use caution if
you must drive.

NWSheadline: HIGH WIND WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 7 AM AKDT SUNDAY

properties.areaDesc: Butts; Jasper; Monroe; Jones
properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 10 at 8:41AM EDT by NWS Peachtree City GA
properties.description:
At 841 AM EDT, National Weather Service doppler radar indicated a
strong storm within a tropical rain band over Juliette, or 9 miles
northeast of Forsyth, moving north at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Enhanced risk of a brief tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Storms embedded within a tropical rainband have exhibited
localized rotation. A brief tornado could quickly form.

Locations impacted include...
McElheneys Crossroads, Berner, Juliette, Adgateville, and Plant
Scherer.
properties.instruction: People outdoors should seek shelter immediately.

NWSheadline: A strong thunderstorm will impact portions of northeastern Monroe, southeastern Butts, northwestern Jones and southern Jasper Counties through 915 AM EDT

properties.areaDesc: Lincoln; McDuffie; Columbia; Richmond; Burke; McCormick; Edgefield; Aiken; Barnwell; Bamberg; Northwestern Orangeburg; Central Orangeburg; Southeastern Orangeburg
properties.headline: Flood Watch issued October 10 at 8:39AM EDT until October 11 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Columbia SC
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Portions of east central Georgia, including the following
areas, Burke, Columbia, Lincoln, McDuffie and Richmond and central
South Carolina, including the following areas, Aiken, Bamberg,
Barnwell, Central Orangeburg, Edgefield, McCormick, Northwestern
Orangeburg and Southeastern Orangeburg.

* WHEN...Through Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks. Flooding may occur
in poor drainage and urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Periods of heavy rainfall are possible today, with highest
amounts expected in the CSRA and southern Midlands. Rainfall
totals of 3-6" are possible from this morning through tonight.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be prepared to take action
should Flash Flood Warnings be issued.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WATCH REMAINS IN EFFECT THROUGH SUNDAY MORNING

properties.areaDesc: Jefferson, FL; Madison, FL; Taylor, FL; Brooks, GA; Lowndes, GA
properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 10 at 8:30AM EDT until October 10 at 10:30AM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Jefferson County in Big Bend Florida...
Western Madison County in Big Bend Florida...
Northwestern Taylor County in Big Bend Florida...
Southwestern Brooks County in south central Georgia...
West Central Lowndes County in south central Georgia...

* WHEN...Until 1030 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 829 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1.5 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2.5 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Quitman, Greenville, Aucilla, Ashville, Ebb, Sirmans, Hamburg,
Moseley Hall, Lovett, Empress, Shady Grove, Lamont, Eridu, Iddo,
Lake Bird, Nankin, Blue Springs and Cabbage Grove.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued October 10 at 8:26AM EDT until October 10 at 10:30AM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
properties.description:
SMWTAE

The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Apalachee Bay or Coastal Waters From Keaton Beach to Ochlockonee
River Fl out to 20 Nm...
Coastal Waters From  Ochlockonee River to Apalachicola FL out to 20
Nm...
Coastal waters from  Suwannee River to Keaton Beach out 20 NM...
Waters from Suwannee River to Apalachicola FL from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 1030 AM EDT.

* At 826 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line extending from 27 nm east of
St. Marks to 25 nm southeast of V Tower, moving northeast at 30
knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can quickly form and capsize boats...damage
vessels...and create suddenly higher waves. Make sure all
on board are in a secure location and wearing life
jackets. Expect wind gusts in excess of 34
knots...suddenly higher waves...frequent lightning...and
heavy downpours. Make sure all on board are wearing life
jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
V Tower and Buckeye Reef.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

properties.areaDesc: Kenedy Island; Willacy Island; Cameron Island
properties.headline: High Surf Advisory issued October 10 at 7:08AM CDT until October 10 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Brownsville TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding.
For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 3 to 6
feet in the surf zone. For the High Rip Current Risk,
dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...Kenedy Island, Willacy Island and Cameron Island
Counties.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 7 AM CDT Sunday.
For the High Surf Advisory, until 7 PM CDT this evening. For
the High Rip Current Risk, through Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...Nuisance flooding is expected, with water reaching or
pushing into the dunes on South Padre Island. Vehicles, except
those with four wheel drive and high wheel bases, will be unable
to be driven on the beach. This includes locations north of
Public Beach Access #3. Minor to moderate beach erosion is
expected. Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion. Rip currents can sweep even the best
swimmers away from shore into deeper water.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.
